{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure clean mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']

# Print the result
highest_mean_species"}
